name: @dspack-studio/block-bench
description: Offline, deterministic measurement for the interface-blocks experiment (docs/BLOCKS.md): exact hosted request goldens (the flag-off byte-identity oracle), output sizes per protocol, the structural-validity vs governance leak table, and draft block sizes. No network, no model calls. `pnpm test` fails on any drift from the committed results.json; `pnpm --filter @dspack-studio/block-bench bench` regenerates it.
